actual.titulo: The Who: Live At The Isle Of Wight Festival 2004
actual.descripcion: In 2004 The Who returned to the Isle Of Wight Festival for the first time since their legendary performance in 1970. Their UK concerts in 2004 were the first in their home country since the death of founder member John Entwistle.
